intro: We hold a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published BCom colleges in India. This list of the best BCom colleges under ₹{{budget}} lakh starts with Delhi University colleges, then other cities.

Hindu College is listed with B.Com (Hons) at ₹26,000, Hansraj College at ₹17,200–₹18,200, and Lady Shri Ram College for Women at ₹21,290, all in our records for 2023-linked placement years. Confirm the latest official college or university fee circular.
Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Delhi NCR, Maharashtra, Karnataka and Punjab have the most listings. CUET UG is the main recorded entrance test.
listLead: These are the top BCom colleges in India 2026 with a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹1 lakh. The first Delhi cards are well-known colleges; later cards include many private colleges with similar fee bands.
snapshot: Across {{feeN}} published colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private, {{public}} are public, and a few have no ownership type. Delhi, Jaipur, Lucknow and Bangalore are the leading cities on this list.
A low recorded total at a public college can still miss examination or society charges. Use the official fee circular for the year you will join.
firstCollegesLead: Loyola College, Chennai, is listed with B.Com General at ₹31,960 and a 2023 average package of ₹8 lakh in our records. That placement figure is historical, not a promise.
Some later fees sit close to ₹11,000. We already drop fees under ₹10,000 from this kind of list, but a figure just above that line may still be an annual tuition rather than a three-year total.

sections.heading: Delhi University colleges and the rest of this BCom list
paragraphs: DU college fees change by year and by college society charges. Our Hindu, Hansraj and LSR figures should be checked against the latest official circular before you budget.
CUET UG is recorded at nine colleges here. Many other BCom admissions follow a university or state process that is not tagged on the card.

compare.heading: How to compare the best BCom colleges under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: A Delhi University honours programme and a private BCom can share this budget and still differ in cut-offs, internships and class size.
bullets: The latest official college fee circular, including society, exam and practical charges.
Whether the programme is B.Com (Hons) or B.Com General, which is not always interchangeable.
The admission route, including CUET UG where it applies.
Living costs in Delhi, Jaipur, Lucknow or Bangalore, which are not part of the tuition figure.

faqs.question: How many BCom colleges in India have fees under ₹1 lakh here?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published BCom colleges with a recorded main-programme fee up to ₹{{budget}} lakh. Colleges without a usable fee on file are excluded.

faqs.question: What is a typical BCom fee on this list?
faqs.answer: The median recorded total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. Delhi University college circulars can differ from our stored figure, so confirm the latest official amount.

faqs.question: What BCom fees do Hindu, Hansraj and LSR show in our records?
faqs.answer: Hindu College is listed at ₹26,000, Hansraj at ₹17,200–₹18,200, and Lady Shri Ram College for Women at ₹21,290, for B.Com (Hons). These are our records, not a substitute for the latest official circular.

faqs.question: Do these colleges admit through CUET UG?
faqs.answer: CUET UG is recorded at nine colleges on this list, including many Delhi University colleges. Other universities may use their own process. Check the official admission page.

faqs.question: Is this a ranking of the best BCom colleges under ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: No. It is a fee filter of the best BCom colleges under ₹1 lakh in our records. Cut-offs and course quality still need a separate check.
